verdict.rationale: Brex ships its own AI agents and assistants, so letting them consume external MCP servers is a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence only documents Brex acting as an MCP server, for example `claude mcp add ... https://api.brex.com/mcp`. That is the server role and does not show Brex plugging in third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Brex's AI acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
